content.comment_body: Hello team, I have a [product_name] controller and would like information on which [product_name] HMIs are compatible. I am interested in using a 4" display with recipe functionality. Please advise on how to configure mapping in the HMI for Up/Down counter variables and timer values, both input and output.

[product_name] devices can communicate with all [product_name] panels. Your questions are somewhat broad. Counter values use a 32-bit format (DInt). To transfer this value to an HMI, utilize the VM memory through the parameter mapping tool, where a DInt is identified as VD. The same approach applies to timers; only the cumulative time value is exchanged, typically as an integer. For example, an off delay of 2 minutes and 30 seconds (using seconds as the base) transmits a value of 150.
You can use, for instance, a 4" [product_name] HMI with Ethernet connectivity or similar compatible [product_name] HMI panels.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to connect [product_name] controller devices with HMI panels, focusing on the need for a 4" HMI that supports recipe capabilities and effective variable mapping for counters and timers. The main challenge involves accurately configuring data communication and mapping 32-bit values within the HMI. Guidance is given about parameter mapping and data formatting, but users request more details on compatible HMI models and specific steps for handling data values.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking clear recommendations on compatible HMI panels, particularly those with a 4" display and recipe support. They expect precise guidance and step-by-step instructions for mapping variables like counters and timers from [product_name] controllers to the HMI.
